fixed.explanation: _collectDB opens an IDBDatabase connection and never closes it, which blocks later deletes or upgrades (restore) while a page is open. The fix closes the connection after collection. I did the same in _restoreDB.

input.intent: Code that collects IndexedDB databases for the browser context storageState (indexedDB: true) via a page-side script, opening databases and reading all records. It likely doesn't close the opened IDBDatabase connection, so a later restore (setStorageState/addInitScript that opens/deletes databases) blocks.
input.symptom: Saving storage state with IndexedDB leaves database connections open, so restoring storage later hangs when a page is open.

history.analysis: _collectDB opens an IDBDatabase connection and never closes it, which blocks later deletes or upgrades (restore) while a page is open. The fix closes the connection after collection. I did the same in _restoreDB.
